chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Al-Husayn ibn Ali Al-Uqayli, from Ali ibn Abi Ali Al-Lahbi, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) put the turban on Ali (peace be upon him) with his hand, so he let it hang from in front of him and shortened it from behind him by the measure of four fingers. Then he said: 'Turn around,' so he turned. Then he said: 'Face me,' so he faced. Then he said: 'This is how the crowns of the angels are.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Prophet's instruction regarding the style of the turban for Imam Ali's turban?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Prophet’s personal grooming of Imam Ali, establishing a specific turban style characterized by a front drape and a shorter back, which the Prophet explicitly identifies as the 'crowns of the angels' (*tijān al-malā’ika*). In Shia tradition, this act is often interpreted not merely as a fashion instruction but as a symbolic bestowal of spiritual authority and angelic status upon the Imam, linking physical adornment to metaphysical rank.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Al Husayn Bin Ali Al Uqayli, from Ali Bin Abdu Ali Al Lahby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> put on the turban on Ali<sup>asws</sup> by his<sup>saww</sup> hand, so he<sup>saww</sup> let it hang from in front of him, and shortened it from behind him of the measurement of four fingers, then said: ‘Turn around’. So he<sup>asws</sup> turned. Then he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Face me<sup>saww</sup>’. So he<sup>asws</sup> faced. Then he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘This is how the Angels are crowned’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from al-Husayn ibn Ali al-‘Aqiliy from Ali ibn abu Ali al- Lahbiy who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, made Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, to wear turban and hanged one end down his front side but made it shorter for the end hanging down his back by four fingers. He (the Messenger of Allah) then asked him to go back which he did and then asked him to come forward which he also did and then he (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘This is how the Tijan (crown) of the angels is.’”
